definition: A visually distinctive object, place, environment, or scene that is clearly present for a meaningful interval.
acceptance_guidance: The authored KIS description can be supported directly by visible raw video evidence with clear semantic identity.
rejection_guidance: Generic scene with no distinctive searchable semantic content.

definition: A person performs a visually identifiable action or body motion.
acceptance_guidance: Action is visible and can be localized to an original-frame interval.
rejection_guidance: Only person presence without a meaningful action.

definition: A visible attribute such as color, clothing, shape, state, appearance, or other observable property is central to retrieval.
acceptance_guidance: Attribute is visually supportable without requiring external knowledge.
rejection_guidance: Attribute is ambiguous or inferred rather than visible.

definition: A meaningful spatial or interaction relation between people, objects, or person-object pairs.
acceptance_guidance: The relation is simultaneously visible and semantically meaningful.
rejection_guidance: Objects merely coexist with no clear relation.

definition: A semantically important object occupies a relatively small image area or is difficult to notice.
acceptance_guidance: The small object is genuinely visible and relevant to the authored query.
rejection_guidance: Object cannot be verified at native/raw-video evidence.

definition: A short-duration action or moment that exists only briefly.
acceptance_guidance: Moment has a defensible narrow original-frame interval.
rejection_guidance: Long persistent action better represented by another category.

definition: An action repeats or similar temporal occurrences exist in the same video, creating temporal ambiguity.
acceptance_guidance: The intended occurrence can still be semantically defined.
rejection_guidance: Only one unambiguous occurrence exists.

definition: Visible text, signage, label, number, caption, or other readable text is central to the semantic query.
acceptance_guidance: Text is actually visible in raw video.
rejection_guidance: Text is guessed or only available from metadata.

definition: Scene contains multiple people/objects or distractors that make semantic localization difficult.
acceptance_guidance: Target remains definable despite visual clutter.
rejection_guidance: Ambiguity makes GT indefensible.

definition: A scene/camera transition or tightly bounded semantic moment is central.
acceptance_guidance: Transition/moment has defensible frame boundaries.
rejection_guidance: Boundary cannot be consistently established.

definition: Question asks for a directly visible color or attribute.
acceptance_guidance: Evidence interval and answer must both be directly supported by raw video; accepted aliases must later represent genuinely equivalent answers.
rejection_guidance: Reject world-knowledge questions; reject subjective interpretation; reject questions with multiple incompatible correct answers.

definition: Ordered sequence of distinguishable semantic states.
acceptance_guidance: Events must be physically/temporally ordered and individually definable and must later support narrow defensible intervals.
rejection_guidance: Reject chains whose events are subjective, unordered, indistinguishable, or cannot be localized independently.
